return function(ctx)
  local function convert(text)
    local rows = {}
    for row in (text:gsub("\r\n", "\n"):gsub("\n$", "") .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do
      rows[#rows + 1] = row
    end
    local columns = 1
    for _ in rows[1]:gmatch("\t") do columns = columns + 1 end
    local output = {}
    for index, row in ipairs(rows) do
      output[#output + 1] = "| " .. row:gsub("|", "\\|"):gsub("\t", " | ") .. " |"
      if index == 1 then
        local cells = {}
        for i = 1, columns do cells[i] = "---" end
        output[#output + 1] = "| " .. table.concat(cells, " | ") .. " |"
      end
    end
    return table.concat(output, "\n")
  end
  local edits = {}
  for _, selection in ipairs(ctx.document.selections) do
    local start = math.min(selection.anchor, selection.head)
    local finish = math.max(selection.anchor, selection.head)
    if start ~= finish then
      edits[#edits + 1] = hedit.edit(start, finish, convert(ctx.document.text:sub(start + 1, finish)))
    end
  end
  if #edits == 0 then return hedit.replace(convert(ctx.document.text)) end
  table.sort(edits, function(a, b) return a.start < b.start end)
  return hedit.transaction(edits)
end
